individual_rule: Among candidates with edit_success=yes, maximize single_quality (1..5); break ties by anonymous candidate id. No admissible candidate means abstain.
joint_rule: Among combinations whose candidates all have edit_success=yes, maximize joint_quality (1..5); break ties by anonymous combination id. This is a retrospective human oracle, not a deployed method.
pilot_signal: A descriptive signal exists only if both stories have oracle minus independent joint_quality >= 1 and oracle acceptable=yes. Two stories do not establish a stable population effect.
evidence_scope: Fixed candidate pool; text-conditioned H3, no new reference weights. Canonical shape requirements are new controlled-task specifications, not relabelled failures of earlier accepted videos. Locked context shots contain no identity anchor for the edited product. Playback is muted; audio is outside scoring. No adaptive budget policy is evaluated.
